## Part 1 · 00:03

[00:03] So, here we are. At the end of what has shockingly become the most successful Kickstarter in history. And by a wide margin. I set out to achieve something, but I didn't expect. I mean, how could I have expected this? I should be thrilled, shouldn't I? Tons of crowdfunding records broken. People excited about four new books that they didn't even know were coming. The fan reaction has been incredible.

[00:49] Who wouldn't be excited? And yet, how am I ever going to deliver a surprise like this again? From now on, the fans will be watching me. Will I ever be able to fool them again? Won't my every future attempt at a trick, twist, or troll be spotted from a thousand miles away? How will I ever top such an incredible, explosive, amazing reveal and subsequent experience? Should should I even try? Perhaps the only answer is to never try to surprise people again.

[01:36] After all, that might be the only truly surprising thing I could do from here on out. Is that it, then? The solution? Is it finally time to stop the secrets? To give up trying to surprise people because I can never top what I've already done. Nah, that's stupid.
